page_title: MOR 1-0 POR | Morocco v Portugal 10/12/2022, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+9' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.

90+7' Pepe (Portugal) receives a lofted pass in the goal area and unleashes a dangerous header which sails narrowly wide of the right post! The ball goes out of play and Morocco will have a goal kick.
90+6' Zakaria Aboukhlal (Morocco) weaves through the defence and gets one-on-one with the keeper, but fails to score.
90+5' Ruben Dias (Portugal) does his best to latch onto a cross into the box, but he can't get to the ball.
90+4' A horde of players are waiting inside the penalty area for a cross from the corner, but Bruno Fernandes (Portugal) takes it short.
90+3' Walid Cheddira (Morocco) does not realise that he has already received a yellow card and is shocked when the referee shows him a second one!
90+1' Facundo Tello shows a yellow card to Walid Cheddira (Morocco) for his blatant foul.
90+1' The linesman signals that Walid Cheddira (Morocco) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.
90+1' A pass into the box finds Cristiano Ronaldo (Portugal) unmarked. He carefully places a shot towards the bottom right corner, but a brilliant last-ditch save by Bono denies him.
90' 8 additional min. will be played.
87' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Vitinha (Portugal) was quite harsh and Facundo Tello didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
87' The corner from Bruno Fernandes (Portugal) is intercepted by the defence.
87' Bruno Fernandes (Portugal) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Portugal.
85' The percentage of ball possession is – 28:72.
84' A free kick into the box, taken by Bruno Fernandes (Portugal), is comfortably cleared by the opposition's defence.
84' Walid Cheddira (Morocco) makes a rough challenge and Facundo Tello blows his whistle for a foul.
83' A corner kick by Portugal is thwarted by the well prepared Bono (Morocco).

83' A sweet pass finds Joao Felix (Portugal) on the edge of the box, and he drills the ball towards the top left corner. Bono is almost caught out but pulls off a brilliant save at the last second. The ball is out of play. Portugal win a corner kick.
82' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Yahya Jabrane (Morocco) comes onto the pitch so that Sofiane Boufal can be given a rest.
81' Here comes a substitution. Zakaria Aboukhlal (Morocco) is brought on as a substitute for Hakim Ziyech.
81' The attendance for today's match is 44198.
79' Fernando Santos is forced to make an unplanned substitution as Diogo Dalot suffers an injury and Ricardo Horta (Portugal) comes on.
79' Hakim Ziyech (Morocco) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
77' Diogo Dalot (Portugal) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
76' Handball by Walid Cheddira (Morocco).
75' Bruno Fernandes (Portugal) overhits the corner kick and none of his teammates can their head on it.

74' Bono leaps to collect the ball from the corner which was sent over by Bruno Fernandes (Portugal). The ball goes behind for a corner. Portugal will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.

74' A lofted cross from Joao Cancelo (Portugal) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area. The ball goes out of play and Portugal have been awarded a corner kick.
73' Bruno Fernandes (Portugal) takes the corner kick and sends a lovely ball into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and knocks the ball to safety.
73' The referee points to the corner flag and Portugal will take a corner. Diogo Dalot (Portugal) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
71' Bernardo Silva (Portugal) wins the ball from the resulting free kick and unleashes a shot which sails miles wide of the right post!
70' Achraf Dari (Morocco) has tested the patience of referee Facundo Tello and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
69' Here is a change. Otavio is going off and Fernando Santos gives the last tactical orders to Vitinha (Portugal).
69' We are about to witness a subsitution. Rafael Leao (Portugal) for Goncalo Ramos.
69' Bruno Fernandes (Portugal) clips a neat ball into the box in the direction of Cristiano Ronaldo, but he can't get on the end of the pass.
68' Joao Cancelo (Portugal) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
68' Achraf Hakimi (Morocco) commits a foul after unfairly battling his opponent for the ball.
66' Badr Benoun (Morocco) was too forceful with his tackle and Facundo Tello interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
65' Walid Regragui has decided to substitute Youssef En Nesyri and he is replaced by Badr Benoun (Morocco).
65' Substitution. Walid Cheddira (Morocco) in, Selim Amallah out.
64' An accurate pass to the edge of the box is well taken by Bruno Fernandes (Portugal), whose instinctive shot towards goal flashes inches over the top.
62' Bruno Fernandes (Portugal) found some space to play in a lofted pass, but he looks disappointed as none of his teammates managed to connect with it.
61' The ball is cleared after Diogo Dalot (Portugal) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. The ball goes out of play and Morocco will have a goal kick.
61' Joao Felix (Portugal) finds himself in a promising position after receiving a clever chip pass, but one of the defending players comes up with a timely interception.
60' Bruno Fernandes (Portugal) fails to deliver a decent cross from a long-range free kick. The opposition's defence intercepts the effort.

60' Yahya Attiat-Allah (Morocco) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Facundo Tello with no other option than to blow for a foul.
59' Azzedine Ounahi (Morocco) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.

58' Goncalo Ramos (Portugal) gets free in the box and latches onto a good cross, but somehow he sends the ball narrowly wide of the right post from the penalty spot with just the keeper to beat. The ball goes out of play and Morocco will have a goal kick.
57' Romain Saiss is substituted due to injury. Walid Regragui gives a chance to Achraf Dari (Morocco).
57' Romain Saiss (Morocco) looks like he won’t be able to continue.
56' Romain Saiss (Morocco) picks up an injury.
56' Azzedine Ounahi (Morocco) receives an accurate pass and attempts to threaten the goalkeeper with his long-range strike. Unfortunately for him, his effort goes high above the crossbar.
55' Diogo Dalot (Portugal) sends a cross into the box, but Bono comes off his line to gather the ball.
52' Cristiano Ronaldo (Portugal) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Bono intercepts the ball.
51' Fernando Santos prepares a substitution. Ruben Neves is replaced by Cristiano Ronaldo (Portugal).
51' Substitution. Raphael Guerreiro will be replaced by Joao Cancelo (Portugal).
50' Jawad El Yamiq (Morocco) is furious with himself as he misses a clear opportunity. He sends a rebound a few inches wide of the right post.
48' Pepe (Portugal) trips an opposition player and Facundo Tello signals a foul.
48' Facundo Tello blows his whistle. Selim Amallah (Morocco) commits a foul after dangerous play.
47' Bruno Fernandes (Portugal) steps up to take the corner. He launches the ball into the penalty area, but it only finds the head of an opposing player who clears the danger.
47' Diogo Dalot (Portugal) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety. Portugal will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+3' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.

45+2' Close! Yahya Attiat-Allah (Morocco) picks up the ball in space and from inside the penalty area sends a shot inches wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Portugal will have a goal kick.
45+2' Bernardo Silva (Portugal) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
45+2' Bruno Fernandes (Portugal) breaks into the box and goes over after a challenge from an opposition player, but the ref signals NO penalty!
45' The fourth official shows 2 min. of added time.
45' What an opportunity! Bruno Fernandes (Portugal) smashed a first-time shot from the edge of the box, but the ball only crashed against the crossbar!
42' 1 - 0 Goal! Youssef En Nesyri (Morocco) makes the score 1:0 after burying a close-range header in the right side of the goal after a good run and cross by Yahya Attiat-Allah.
41' Joao Felix (Portugal) is caught offside!
40' Sofyan Amrabat (Morocco) commits a rough foul. Facundo Tello stops the game and makes a call.
39' It wasn't the best example of how to strike the ball. Joao Felix (Portugal) unleashed a first-time shot from the edge of the box that went high over the crossbar.
39' Sofiane Boufal (Morocco) feels very aggrieved after the referee stops play for a foul that he commits while heading towards goal with the ball.
37' Joao Felix (Portugal) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent.
36' Ruben Neves (Portugal) is penalised for holding. Facundo Tello signals a set piece.
35' Sofiane Boufal (Morocco) dribbles his way to the edge of the box and drills a shot low towards the middle of the goal, but Diogo Costa is equal to the effort and makes a good save.
35' What a big chance! Selim Amallah (Morocco) picks up an inch-perfect pass inside the box and skies the ball well over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Portugal.
33' The game is interrupted as Goncalo Ramos (Portugal) is flagged offside.
33' Bruno Fernandes (Portugal) fails to find a teammate across the pitch with a long ball.
32' Bruno Fernandes (Portugal) takes the corner with a short pass.

31' Joao Felix (Portugal) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal. Corner kick. Portugal will have an opportunity.
29' Raphael Guerreiro (Portugal) did his best to latch on to a crossfield pass, but it was too long and it goes out of play.

26' Youssef En Nesyri (Morocco) reacts well and displays good awareness near the penalty spot to get on the end of a cross from the free kick. He jumps high and produces a header which goes well wide of the right post.
25' Foul! Ruben Neves (Portugal) is penalised for pulling back his opponent.
24' Facundo Tello blows his whistle and it's Bruno Fernandes (Portugal) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
23' Joao Felix (Portugal) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away. The referee and the linesman both signal a throw-in for Portugal.
22' Hakim Ziyech (Morocco) works the corner short instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
22' Hakim Ziyech (Morocco) puts a cross into the box from the corner but there is no panic from the opposition and they easily clear. It will be a corner kick for Morocco.
22' Hakim Ziyech (Morocco) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked. Morocco have been awarded a corner kick.
21' Hakim Ziyech (Morocco) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Diogo Costa, who smothers the ball.
20' Ruben Neves (Portugal) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Facundo Tello has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
18' Hakim Ziyech (Morocco) picks up a wayward pass but gives away possession by shooting from distance. The ball went miles wide of the right post.
17' Achraf Hakimi (Morocco) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
16' Raphael Guerreiro (Portugal) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit cross to the back post.
15' Raphael Guerreiro (Portugal) did his best to latch on to a crossfield pass, but it was too long and it goes out of play.
13' Raphael Guerreiro (Portugal) latches onto a loose ball inside the box, but his first-time strike at goal is blocked by a defender.
12' Sofyan Amrabat (Morocco) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Facundo Tello saw the whole situation.
11' Chance! Selim Amallah (Morocco) was in a good position inside the box, but he couldn't connect with the pass as it was overhit.
7' Diogo Dalot (Portugal) did his best to latch on to a crossfield pass, but it was too long and it goes out of play.
7' The corner is bent into the box and met with a firm header by Youssef En Nesyri (Morocco), but it's just over the bar.
6' Hakim Ziyech (Morocco) is about to take a corner kick.
6' Yahya Attiat-Allah (Morocco) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Morocco.
5' Bruno Fernandes (Portugal) launches an inaccurate corner kick into the penalty area.

5' Joao Felix (Portugal) leaps highest in the penalty area to get on the end of a cross from the set piece, and he produces a promising goal-bound header towards the right side of the goal, but Bono pulls off a decent save to deny him. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Portugal.
4' Yahya Attiat-Allah (Morocco) knocks his opponent down with an over-the-top tackle.
3' Portugal string together a series of short passes.
